name: astronode-firebase
description: AstroNode Firebase güvenlik kuralları ve testleri

scripts.test:functions: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-astronode-fn "cd functions && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs"
scripts.deploy:functions: cd functions && npm ci && cd .. && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:functions && npm run test:tools
